changes: File access and exact byte hashes are managed by StepService.
Shared bounded Part21 parser replaces the PMI reader parser.
Procedural decoding has no CAD imports and uses iterative graph traversal.
Review output is validated in memory before exclusive atomic publication.
Part21 byte bounds use UTF-8 bytes and reject Boolean limit values.
Procedural numeric scalars and reference lists reject mismatched token types.
Nonfinite JSON constants and duplicate JSON keys are rejected.
Nominal measures use explicit length or plane-angle types matched to dimension families and unit classes.
JSON floating-point overflow is rejected during metadata decoding.
The service validates a bounded HEADER and single DATA exchange grammar; it does not validate EXPRESS.
